id: title:haacked:bound the replica hash key override insert with a timeout

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a PostgreSQL statement timeout configuration for the feature-flag hash-key override storage, bounded by the caller's deadline, with runtime assertions to prevent configuration errors.
review.reason: Adds a bounded PostgreSQL statement timeout configuration parameter with runtime assertions and propagation to storage, supporting database reliability and configuration safety.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of a bounded configuration parameter and its propagation, but the actual runtime behavior and failure recovery are not demonstrated. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No adoption, incident, or benefit claims are supported; tier assignment requires score, not just observations.

observations.behavior: Adds a new configuration parameter, hash_key_override_statement_timeout_ms, to the Config struct, with a default of 2000 and an upper bound of i32::MAX.
observations.posthog_connection: This parameter controls the PostgreSQL statement_timeout for the INSERT into the feature-flags hash-key override table, bounded by the caller's deadline.

observations.behavior: Adds a runtime assertion to the storage creation, checking that the new timeout parameter is within the valid range [1, i32::MAX].
observations.posthog_connection: This check prevents configuration errors from propagating into the storage initialization.

observations.behavior: Passes the new timeout parameter to the PostgresStorage constructor, including it in the set of configuration arguments.
observations.posthog_connection: This connects the configuration value to the storage implementation, allowing it to be used in SQL execution.
